title: 100 lbs (45 kg) cheat curls for 4
summary: Lift clip of 100 lb (45 kg) cheat curls for 4 reps; transcript is only background music. The description says triceps are his current priority to reach 19-inch arms, but he keeps cheat curls (supinated dumbbell cleans) and warns beginners not to try them.

claims.claim: Triceps are his number one priority right now to reach 19-inch arms, so biceps development has taken a back seat.
Heavy cheat curls (which he calls supinated dumbbell cleans) are a staple he can't go long without, but they are not for people new to biceps training.

exercises.name: Cheat curl
exercises.why: heavy biceps overload; not for beginners
